entities.name: J. P. R. Williams

entities.summary: John Peter Rhys Williams was a Welsh rugby union player who represented Wales in international rugby during their Golden Era in the 1970s. He became known universally as J. P. R. Williams four years after his Welsh debut, in 1973 when J. J. Williams joined the Welsh team.
